title: findings
description: What a review found, each its level, where it is, what it is, why it was left if it was, and what became of it

level.description: must to fix, should, or a nit

at.description: Where it is, such as internal/tmpl/part.go:412

why.description: Why it was left as it is; a line of Markdown

status.description: What became of it, such as { pill: fixed, tone: good }.
